dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 03, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MVPs Shine in MLB Action as Marlins and Dodgers Extend Winning Streaks**

In a thrilling slate of games, several MVP-caliber performances stole the show. Esteury Ruiz of the Miami Marlins hit a home run and drove in a run in a 4-1 win over the Washington Nationals, while Max Meyer pitched 7 scoreless innings to earn the win. 

On the other side of the country, Shohei Ohtani of the Los Angeles Dodgers tossed a shutout, striking out six batters and earning his 6th win of the season in a 7-0 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks. Kyle Tucker had a big day at the plate, going 3-for-5 with a home run and 2 RBIs.

In the American League, Dillon Dingler of the Detroit Tigers blasted a home run and drove in 4 runs in a 7-2 win over the Tampa Bay Rays, while Troy Melton earned the win with 8 strong innings.
